from fractions import Fraction


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    prefix = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i, value in enumerate(a):
        prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + value

    # Candidate starting prefix indices for each ending prefix index.
    hull = []
    head = 0
    best_num, best_den = 0, 1

    def slope_cmp(num1: int, den1: int, num2: int, den2: int) -> int:
        left = num1 * den2
        right = num2 * den1
        return (left > right) - (left < right)

    for end in range(k, n + 1):
        start = end - k

        # Keep the lower convex hull of eligible prefix points (i, prefix[i]).
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            i, j = hull[-2], hull[-1]
            cross = (j - i) * (prefix[start] - prefix[j]) - (start - j) * (prefix[j] - prefix[i])
            if cross <= 0:
                hull.pop()
            else:
                break
        hull.append(start)

        # The best start maximizes the slope to (end, prefix[end]).
        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            i, j = hull[head], hull[head + 1]
            num_i, den_i = prefix[end] - prefix[i], end - i
            num_j, den_j = prefix[end] - prefix[j], end - j
            if num_i * den_j <= num_j * den_i:
                head += 1
            else:
                break

        start = hull[head]
        num, den = prefix[end] - prefix[start], end - start
        if num * best_den > best_num * den:
            best_num, best_den = num, den

        if head > 1024:
            hull = hull[head:]
            head = 0

    fraction = Fraction(best_num, best_den)
    return [fraction.numerator, fraction.denominator]
